newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Sakura, CIB advisors for Budapest power development.
newsitem.headline: Sakura, CIB advisors for Budapest power development.

text.p: Sakura Bank and Hungary's CIB Bank were chosen as financial advisors for a 20 billion forints development of the Ujpest power plant belonging to Budapesti Eromu Rt, CIB said on Monday.
"The new owners' first priority is the overhaul and extension of the Ujpest power plant," CIB said in a statement.
Finland's Imatran Voima (IVO) and Japanese trading house Tomen bought a joint 73.7 percent stake in Budapesti in March for $47 million.
Budapesti has five heat and power generating plants and one district heating plant, which together produce about 250 megawatts of electricity and 2,500 megawatts of heat.
Privatisation agency APV said at the time of the sale that the new owners were committed to investments of at least $200 million and they would decide later on spending further $250 million.
